title: Create Video Games with Phaser.js Skill Path
body:
The Phaser.js Certificate represents an exceptional level of expertise in creating captivating and immersive cross-platform games. This comprehensive certification program empowers developers with in-depth knowledge of game mechanics, animations, and responsive design principles within the Phaser.js framework. With this certification in hand, game developers gain the skills to craft visually stunning and interactive gaming experiences, ranging from 2D platformers to action-packed adventures and casual puzzles.

Phaser.js-certified professionals demonstrate a deep commitment to staying at the forefront of the gaming industry, consistently pushing the boundaries of interactivity and engagement. By seamlessly integrating with multidisciplinary teams, these certified experts contribute to the success of ambitious gaming projects, delivering polished and engaging gameplay that captivates audiences worldwide.

title: NDG Linux Essentials
body:
The NDG Linux Essentials Certificate signifies a comprehensive understanding of the fundamental principles and skills required to navigate the world of Linux with confidence. This distinguished certification program equips learners with the knowledge to interact with the Linux operating system, gaining insights into essential command-line operations, file management, and basic system administration. As a certified Linux Essentials professional, individuals are well-prepared to excel in a variety of IT roles, as Linux serves as the backbone of countless technological infrastructures.

With the NDG Linux Essentials Certificate, learners gain a solid grasp of Linux concepts, empowering them to troubleshoot and solve common problems, ensuring seamless operation and maintenance of Linux-based environments. Whether pursuing a career in system administration, networking, or software development, this certification acts as a powerful stepping stone, demonstrating the holder's mastery of Linux fundamentals and commitment to excellence in the IT industry. Employers seeking skilled professionals with a strong foundation in Linux can rely on NDG Linux Essentials certified individuals to bring reliability, efficiency, and versatility to their organizations' technological endeavors.

title: Learn CSS Course
body:
In this course you will learn how to use CSS to style your web pages. You will be able to use it to control the styling and layout of multiple pages all at once. You will also learn how to make your pages more interactive with CSS animations. Using what I learned in this course I was able to create this website. After completing this course I feel confident in my ability to create a website from scratchand utilizing classes, ids, and other CSS selectors to style the page.

Next step I am taking after this course is working towards certification on API callings and JavaScript frameworks such as Phaser and React!

title: National Platinum Certification ACT WorkKeys NCRC
body:
This credential is based on ACT’s world-renowned WorkKeys® assessments which remain the only proven system for linking job skills with workplace success. Knowledge and skills related to job tasks are the strongest predictors of work performance. By earning the NCRC, this individual has demonstrated the following skills at the Certificate Level indicated on this screen:

• Problem solving
• Critical thinking
• Reading and using written, work-related text
• Applying information from workplace documents to solve problems
• Applying mathematical reasoning to work-related problems
• Setting up and performing work-related mathematical calculations
• Locating, synthesizing, and applying information that is presented graphically
• Comparing, summarizing, and analyzing information presented in multiple, related graphics

The Platinum level is the highest and only achived by 1% of test takers. The certificate can be verified at ACT's website. Certificate ID: 0JW5K9613ZN1
